title: RSL risk-based audit referral contract and fixture
scope: Add a TAX-111-style assumed contract for audit referrals from RSL's risk-based audit system on PSRM (case reference, TIN, risk sets and scores owned by RSL, selection reason) and open a Vati investigation linked to that RSL case

acceptance.text: Contract rsl.audit_system.referral.v0-assumed with fixture records that identify themselves as fixtures; no real host, path or field name invented
A referral opens or reuses one Vati case linked to the RSL audit case reference; RSL risk-set scores are stored as RSL-owned inputs and never relabelled as Vati scores
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Contract and adapter tests; a fixture referral opens one linked case and replays idempotently

notes.text: Added 2026-11-07 from ADR-043 (Vati downstream of RSL selection; portal answers evidence requests).
2026-11-11 (ADR-045): owner changed from Keletso to Gupta; RSL integration lane. No task in this lane depends on an open task in the other lane.
